texts.zh:
[from.GetName]上极端热信号的源头找到了。

遍布行星的间歇泉从地表深处释放出高度易燃的氢气。这些间歇泉喷发时，气体就被行星的热量点燃，产生直抵云霄的巨大火柱。

再和大气压力相结合，就产生了极不稳定的气流，以巨大的火焰龙卷风的形式横扫地面。

尽管这是一种极具破坏力的自然现象，但我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower]很确信这些龙卷风以及其产生的大量动能可以人为地复现并加以利用。
texts.en:
The source of the extreme heat signatures on [from.GetName] has been discovered.

Across the planet, geysers are emitting highly flammable hydrogen gas from deep below the surface. As these geysers erupt, the planet's heat ignites the gas, resulting in vast pillars of flame blasting into the skies.

When combined with the atmospheric pressure, this creates extremely volatile air currents, sending streams of fire swirling across the landscape in the form of massive, flaming tornadoes.

While a devastating natural phenomena, our [Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower] are confident that these tornadoes, and the vast volumes of kinetic energy they generate, could be recreated artificially for practical use.

texts.en: By studying the conditions behind the flaming tornadoes of [from.GetName] more closely, the benefits of this phenomena could be recreated in a controlled environment.

有了这一突破，我们就能够利用的恒星基地来增加在同一星系中发现的所有熔融星球所产出的能量。
texts.en:
[from.Leader.GetName] has successfully found a way to recreate and harness the flaming tornadoes found on [from.From.GetName] in a controlled environment.

With this breakthrough, we will be able to use our starbases to increase the energy produced by any molten worlds that are found in the same system.

texts.zh: 这项科学理论与我们目前对电弧熔炉的理解有许多异曲同工之处，打开了域外建筑学领域的许多全新可能。
texts.en: The scientific theory shares many parallels with our existing understanding of Arc Furnaces, opening new possibilities for offworld construction.

summary.text:
# 极端温度 / Extreme Temperatures

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:649; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1915 (extreme_frontiers.360); common/special_projects/05_projects_extreme_frontiers.txt (INFERNAL_CATALYSTS_PROJECT); events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1951 (extreme_frontiers.365)

## 如何开始 How it starts

熔岩星球可能生成（6级，权重3，全局一次 max_once；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a molten planet (level 6, weight 3, once per game via max_once; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.360“火龙卷”：d_energy_5 与 d_exotic_gases_1 矿藏，并启用项目 INFERNAL_CATALYSTS_PROJECT“炼狱催化剂”（180天）。完成后 extreme_frontiers.365“熔岩碎屑共振器”：推进 tech_pyroclastic_resonation 15%；若有机器时代 DLC 且已有轨道电弧炉科技则另推进太空采矿科技。

Single result extreme_frontiers.360 "Flaming Tornadoes": d_energy_5 and d_exotic_gases_1 deposits and enables project INFERNAL_CATALYSTS_PROJECT (180 days). Completion fires extreme_frontiers.365 "Pyroclastic Resonators": 15% progress on tech_pyroclastic_resonation, and with The Machine Age plus tech_orbital_arc_furnace additional space-mining tech progress.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一路径：360 → 项目 → 365。

Single path: 360 -> project -> 365.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

365 的描述对机器时代 DLC 与轨道电弧炉科技有变体。

365's description varies with The Machine Age and tech_orbital_arc_furnace.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
